column2: Towering three-legged engines armed with the Heat-Ray.
Canisters of a heavy, inky vapour that clings to the ground and kills everything it touches.
A war of extermination. There is nothing to negotiate.
Fighting machines adapted to wade, swim and carry their kin across the seas.
Hollow fighting machines that carry others of their kind across the water.
Fight the invaders until they are gone. There is nothing to negotiate.
